trans-unit.source: Do I need experience to start?

trans-unit.source: No. Plenty of people start without ever having touched a barbell. We start where you are, and your plan grows with you.

trans-unit.source: What is the difference between personal training and online coaching?
trans-unit.target: Wat is het verschil tussen personal training en online coaching?

trans-unit.source: With personal training, I'm next to you in the gym. With online coaching, you train on your own and I guide you with a plan in your client dashboard, a weekly check-in and feedback on your videos.
trans-unit.target: Bij personal training sta ik naast je in de sportschool. Bij online coaching train je zelf en begeleid ik je met een plan in je klantendashboard, een wekelijkse check-in en feedback op je video's.

trans-unit.source: Do I need a gym membership?
Most programs are made for a regular gym, but training at home is possible too. Tell me what equipment you have and I'll build the plan around it.
trans-unit.target: De meeste schema's zijn gemaakt voor een gewone sportschool, maar thuis trainen kan ook. Vertel me welk materiaal je hebt, dan bouw ik het plan daaromheen.

trans-unit.source: How quickly will I see results?

That depends on where you start, how consistently you train and eat, how well you sleep, and your body. Most people notice they're getting stronger before they see a change in the mirror. No honest coach can promise a specific result or date.
trans-unit.target: Dat hangt af van waar je begint, hoe consequent je traint en eet, hoe goed je slaapt en van je lichaam. De meeste mensen merken eerst dat ze sterker worden, en zien pas later verschil in de spiegel. Geen eerlijke coach kan je een bepaald resultaat of een datum beloven.

trans-unit.source: Do you help with food and diet?
trans-unit.target: Help je ook met voeding en dieet?

trans-unit.source: Yes, with practical guidance that fits your training: calorie and macro targets and a simple meal structure. Detailed meal plans are part of the Premium and Contest Prep packages. For a medical diet, please see a dietitian.

trans-unit.source: Monthly packages can be cancelled before the next billing date. If a package has a minimum term, it's stated on the pricing page and in the terms of service.
